raw.details:
About the Opportunity:
  • WIE HackEarth 2.0 2026 is a Pan-India hackathon organized by the IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) Affinity Group under the IEEE Galgotias University Student Branch, with IEEE Computational Intelligence Society (CIS) as co-organizer and in collaboration with Medhasphere, the Departmental Club of AI/ML.
  • Built around the theme “Empowering Women. Engineering a Sustainable, Intelligent Future,” the hackathon aims to bring together students and innovators to develop technology-driven solutions for real-world challenges.
  • Participants will have the opportunity to transform ideas into practical solutions while demonstrating innovation, technical skills, creativity, teamwork, and human-centred problem-solving.
  • The hackathon focuses on creating solutions with meaningful social and environmental impact.
Highlights:
  •  Pan-India Hackathon
  • Theme: Empowering Women. Engineering a Sustainable, Intelligent Future
  • Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
  • Healthcare Innovation
  • Cybersecurity & Digital Safety
  • Sustainable Engineering
  • Human-Centred Problem Solving
  • Prize Pool: Up to ₹1,00,000
  • Exciting goodies for Top 20 performers
  • Final offline hackathon at Galgotias University, Greater Noida
  • join the whatsapp group for further notifications and guidelines: https://chat.whatsapp.com/CuMbyBmrdeXDpoHyE25dLj?mode=gi_t
  • Do checkout the Website too: https://ieeegusbwiehackearth20.vercel.app
Eligibility:
  • Open to participants from across India.
  • Students, developers, innovators, technology enthusiasts, and problem-solvers are encouraged to participate.
  • Every team must have at least one female member.
  • Team size : 2-4 member
  • Participants are expected to follow all submission and participation guidelines provided by the organizers.
Hackathon Rounds

Round 1 — Registration & PPT Submission

Registration Timeline:
2 November 2026, 12:00 PM – 16 November 2026, 11:59 PM

  • Register your team through Unstop during the registration window.
  • Teams will be required to submit their PPT/idea presentation for the screening round.
  • The official PPT Template will be updated on this opportunity page within the next couple of days.
  • Participants must prepare and submit their PPT according to the prescribed template and guidelines.
  • Teams should ensure that their submission is clear, complete, and appropriately structured as per the official template.

PPT Screening Round

10 November 2026 – 16 November 2026

  • Submitted PPTs will be reviewed and evaluated by the organizing team.
  • Shortlisting will be based on the quality and potential of the proposed idea, along with its innovation, feasibility, relevance, and impact.
  • Teams are advised to carefully follow the official PPT template while preparing their submissions.

Results Announcement

16 November – 18 November 2026

  • Shortlisted teams will be announced during this period.
  • Selected teams will receive further instructions regarding the final offline hackathon.
Round 2 — Final Offline Hackathon
  • Shortlisted teams will participate in the final offline hackathon at Galgotias University, Greater Noida.
  • Shortlisted teams will be required to pay an entry fee of up to ₹400 per team for participation in the final offline round.
  • Special Benefit for All-Female Teams: If all members of a team are female, the team will be eligible for a 50% discount on the final offline hackathon entry fee.
  • Teams will work on their ideas and develop practical solutions addressing real-world challenges.
  • Further details regarding the final offline hackathon will be communicated to shortlisted teams.
Perks & Awards

Prize Pool — Up to ₹1,00,000

Compete for a prize pool of up to ₹1 Lakh and showcase your innovation on a platform built around technology, sustainability, and impact.

Goodies for Top 20 Performers

The Top 20 performers at the final offline hackathon will receive exciting goodies.

Build. Innovate. Make an Impact.

Get the opportunity to work alongside fellow innovators, transform your ideas into practical solutions, and experience an innovation-driven hackathon environment.

Rules:
  • Every team must have at least one female member.
  • Teams must submit their PPT according to the official template provided by the organizers.
  • Participants must ensure that their submitted information and idea are accurate and complete.
  • Teams must follow all instructions and deadlines communicated by the organizers.
  • Any form of plagiarism, copied work, cheating, or misconduct may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must maintain professional and respectful conduct throughout the event.
  • Additional rules and guidelines for the final offline hackathon will be communicated to shortlisted teams.
Important Information:
  • The official PPT Template will be uploaded on this Unstop opportunity page within the next couple of days.
  • Participants are advised to regularly check the opportunity page for updates, announcements, and submission instructions.
  • Registration closes on 16 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
  • PPT screening will take place from 10 November to 16 November 2026.
  • Results will be announced between 16 November and 18 November 2026.
  • Only shortlisted teams will proceed to the final offline hackathon.
  • Shortlisted teams will be informed about the final-round participation process and payment details.
  • The final offline hackathon will be hosted at Galgotias University, Greater Noida.
Ready to Reimagine Technology?

Bring your team.
Bring your ideas.
Build for impact.

Register for WIE HackEarth 2.0 2026 and take your idea from concept to creation.

WIE HackEarth 2.0 2026

Reimagining Technology. Empowering Change.
